description:
Kepler’s Kids is a team of young innovators passionate about technology, AI, data science and solving real-world problems. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are tackling Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data, aiming to build a data-driven solution that helps farmers make better agricultural decisions using NASA satellite data.

We welcome collaborators skilled in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, GIS, agriculture, soil science, UI/UX and research. If you're curious, creative and ready to build, join
